name: pca
expr: [coeff, score, latent, tsquared, explained, mu] = pca(X);
comment: Sig: [coeff, score, latent, tsquared, explained, mu] = pca(X). Eigendecomposition of cov(X) for principal components. coeff is signed-undefined (eigenvector orientation), so abs() is taken in fingerprints. Bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b on |coeff|, latent, explained, mu, tsquared.
